extensions.source: Web: apps/web/src/styles/app.css (semantic roles are hex in :root and .dark; the OKLCH sky/pink/yellow/green/red/slate ramps in @theme are step colours components do not use). Phone: apps/mobile/src/theme/colors.ts (light + dark). Frontmatter keys dark-* are the .dark values of the same web roles; phone-* are the phone's own values where they differ from the web.

surface-2.note: Column heads, group bands, the search pill, resting initials tiles.

ink-3.note: 4.7:1 on white, 4.5:1 on the grey bands.

ink-4.note: Never text that has to be read.

accent-solid.note: Primary button and switch fill; white on it is 4.9:1.

figure.purpose: The large tabular number in a FigureGrid cell; 1.375rem below 640px.

period.purpose: Month or week heading in Calendar and Finance; first letter capitalised.

body.purpose: Names, rows, buttons; summaries stop at 65-72ch.

phone-title.purpose: System font; large headings inside a screen.

phone-section.purpose: Section heads on phone screens, with a count at the right.

phone-body.purpose: Row titles and inputs (17px keeps iOS from zooming).

shadows.name: piece
shadows.purpose: The selected piece of a pill track: segmented control, card tabs, attendance track. The phone uses a native 1px / 0.08 shadow for the same role.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Sheets, popovers, menus, confirm dialogs, toasts.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, selection and focus on controls; press scales to 0.98.

motion.name: sheet-in-right
motion.purpose: Sheet arriving from the right (768px and up).

motion.name: sheet-in-up
motion.purpose: Sheet rising from the bottom on phones.

motion.name: peg-in
motion.purpose: An initials tile settling after attendance is marked.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Loading skeletons on the web; the phone breathes opacity over 900ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition collapse under prefers-reduced-motion; the phone skips the skeleton breath.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Phone layout ends; inputs no longer forced to 16px.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Sheets move from the bottom to the right side.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail and top bar replace the tab bar; buttons drop from 44 to 38px.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Settings shows its sticky section index.

touch.method: Web: pointer: coarse ::after extension on controls under 44px. Phone: hitSlop up to 44px on small buttons, chips and icon buttons.

narrative.overview:
The panel is a working tool that steps out of the way. A white canvas, neutral greys, 1px hairlines and one HelloKido blue carry the whole interface; colour is spent only on meaning: a status dot, a lesson-type dot, the one filled button in an area. The look follows the Vizion Menu dashboard the owner approved: cards with a header, a ruled body and a footer link; grey bands for column heads and groups; pill controls; square initials tiles for people.

There are two surfaces with one vocabulary. The web panel (Vite, React, Tailwind 4) is pure white with neutral greys. The iPhone app (Expo, "Template 2") sits on a warm grey canvas with white cards of 18px radius, the system font, the phone's own large titles, tab bar, switches and action sheets. Marks, dots, share bars, tiles and the seat board look the same on both.

Density is a working tool's: readable between lessons, numbers in tabular figures, everything opens on the current day, week or month. Light is the default; both surfaces have a full dark theme with the same roles.
keyCharacteristics: One blue voice; every other hue is a signal with one meaning, shown mostly as a dot.
Hairlines before shadows; shadows only for the selected piece of a pill track and floating layers.
Cards are the one container: header, border-t body, optional footer with an underlined link.
Pills for controls, rounded squares for people, 16px (web) / 18px (phone) for containers.
Native on the phone: system font, native tabs, native switches and pickers, haptics on selection.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: HelloKido blue is the only accent. Emphasis uses Deep Blue, Blue Ink or a blue wash, never a new hue.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where the admin has something to do. No decorative or category amber (the duyusal dot is the one type colour in that family).

rules.name: The Absence Is Grey Rule
rules.body: Attendance reads: attended green, absent grey, make-up pink, forgotten amber. An absence is counted, never shown as danger. Red is kept for failure and for a seat beyond the planned six.

rules.name: The Dot Carries the Hue Rule
rules.body: Status colour sits in a 5–6px dot, a tinted ink and a tinted outline on a white chip; filled colour blocks are reserved for the primary button.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every time, count, date number and amount is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Turkish Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts are typed and shown the Turkish way in every interface language (13.850 or 13.850,50 followed by ₺).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case; a localised month or weekday heading capitalises only its first letter. No uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: The card is the panel's container. Groups inside a card are grey bands and hairline-divided rows, never a card inside a card.

rules.name: The Current Period Rule
rules.body: Calendar and Finance open on the current week or month; time-based data is shown as a calendar before a list.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: If a line can separate it, a line separates it. Shadows mark only a chosen piece or a layer above the page; never a coloured glow.

rules.name: The Pill and Square Rule
rules.body: Things you press are pills; people are squares; containers are soft rectangles. A round avatar appears only for the signed-in account.

dos: Do use the semantic roles from `apps/web/src/styles/app.css` and `apps/mobile/src/theme/colors.ts`, never the raw sky/pink/yellow ramps.
Do build every new page from Page, Card (header / body / footer with CardLink), Band, FigureGrid and Section boxed.
Do show status as a Mark (outlined chip with a dot) and people as square initials tiles.
Do keep amber for "needs your action", grey for absence and red for failure or over-capacity only.
Do keep every control a pill and give it a 44px touch area on touch screens.
Do set numbers in tabular figures and amounts in Turkish format in all three languages.
Do open every task in a sheet: from the right at 768px and up, from the bottom on phones.
Do use the phone's own pieces (large titles, tab bar, switches, date picker, action sheets, haptics) instead of drawing them.
Do keep motion between 150 and 320ms, ease-out-expo for arrivals, and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't use gradients, gradient text or coloured glow shadows (the loading shimmer is the only gradient).
Don't nest a card inside a card; group with bands and hairlines.
Don't add side-stripe accents (a coloured left border on rows, cards or notices).
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons; icons are Phosphor on the web and SF Symbols on the phone.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a second type family on a surface.
Don't colour an absence red or fill a status chip with solid colour.
Don't use uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't "fix" the approved patterns: outlined dot chips, pill buttons, square initials tiles, grey band heads, cards with header and footer, blue promo pills, lesson-type dots.
Don't restyle the public calendar (`#/takvim`) from this file; it keeps its own look.
